data.name: Righteous Cause
data.description: You can lift a crowd's emotions and turn them toward a common purpose. First, you must fascinate the crowd, and then use incite violence without designating a target, at which point you can use righteous cause. Instead of driving the crowd with anger, you fill them with purpose. Fascinated creatures must make Will saves (DC %1) to resist. Those who fail are affected by mass suggestion of a plausible idea that lingers with them for one day. Typical uses of this ability are to spark rebellion, overthrow a king, build a beneficial structure such as an orphanage, or donate money to a cause.|RighteousCauseDC
